title: Granular eviction prioritizer, SLI mapper, and canary harness for multi-region shedding
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: build and roll out a production-grade eviction prioritizer that maps token-level SLI signals into a weighted eviction score, surfaces the score in dashboards, and exposes a canary harness to validate multi-region shedding behavior before global policy changes. This ticket covers instrumentation, score algorithm, dashboard buildout, canary plan, and a short runbook for manual overrides. The prioritizer will be used by admission and circuit components to make fine-grained load-shedding decisions during regional congestion and to improve graceful degradation across Dedicated and Hosted fleets.
acceptance_criteria: Token-level SLI ingestion: per-request token latency percentiles (p50/p90/p95/p99) and decode-step time must be emitted and available in the observability pipeline.
Eviction scoring: a deterministic score (0-100) combining token-latency deviation, KV-hit degradation, and tenant priority is implemented and persisted for the last 30m window.
Dashboards: new panels for eviction-score histogram, tenant SLI drift, regional failover timeline, and canary traffic traces are present in the Console and linked from the incident runbook.
Canary harness: a multi-region canary that replays synthetic traffic and triggers the prioritizer to validate shedding decisions is runnable and automatable through the CI pipeline.
Rollback/playbook: documented rollback steps and manual overrides for emergency circuit changes are in the runbook and tested during the canary.
Non-regression: no measurable increase in tail latency for high-priority tenants when prioritizer is on in canary mode (<=5% impact to p99 over baseline).
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting — agreed scope includes SLI mapping, score model, dashboard wireframes, canary plan. Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Lina (SRE), Tomas (Platform).
2026-03-03: Instrumentation spike completed — added token-latency tags (tenant_id, route, seq_len, kv_hit) to synthetic prober and existing tracing; verified in dev cluster. Sample log: trace_id=...

2026-03-05: Prototype scoring algorithm drafted. Formula uses p95 delta normalized by baseline, KV-hit penalty (0.0-1.0), and tenant weight multiplier. Chose sigmoid scaling to avoid hard cutoffs after reviewing trade-offs with Lina.

2026-03-07: Dashboard mockups reviewed with PM and Design. Decided to add a heatmap for per-tenant SLI drift and a scatter panel showing eviction score vs request rate. UX feedback: show tenant tier badge and link to account usage page.

2026-03-09: PR #4821 opened (platform/eviction-prioritizer). Implements scoring, REST endpoint for score lookup, and a metrics exporter for eviction_score gauge. CI failing on a flaky test; investigating.

2026-03-11: Canary harness prototype wired into synthetic-replayer. Canary config includes two regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1), 10% of synthetic traffic, and a step that injects KV-degradation on eu-west to validate regional spillover behavior.

2026-03-13: Safety review with SRE — added conservative default weights and a dry-run mode for the prioritizer. SRE requested audit logs for every eviction decision (tenant_id, score, policy_version).
decisions: Use rolling 30m windows for score aggregation to reduce noise from transient microbursts.
Adopt a sigmoid scaler on raw deviation to limit score amplification from extreme outliers.
Default policy: conservative eviction only for score >= 70 when region load > 85% and p99 latency delta > 30% of baseline.
Expose 'dry-run' and 'enforce' flags; start with dry-run enabled for two weeks in us-east before enabling enforcement globally.
